Provider error bodies (secret token, redirect host) never persisted; DB outage is {code: STORE_UNAVAILABLE} with no driver text; run error is {code, module_id} only; rejected surrogate input is not echoed by the validation handler; secrets redacted and worker exceptions logged by class only; provider absence is the typed AGENT_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE on the intake wire. Declared types are pdf, xlsx, json, txt, md, csv (ALLOWED_SUFFIXES). Acceptance is proven for pdf, xlsx, json and txt; no retained passed test admits a valid .md or .csv source (both appear only in rejection tests: evidence-free and non-UTF-8). Add one acceptance case each for .md and .csv.

Proven: unsupported extension is 415 at the helper, the source route and the intake; .pdf/.xlsx suffixes with non-PDF/non-workbook bytes are refused by the parser (422). Not proven and not implemented: admission keys on the filename suffix only, the client media type is stored unverified (SPEC_RECONCILIATION 'Filename and media type are not BoundaryText') and no byte-signature sniff exists, so a media-type mismatch or a text file carrying another format's signature is not refused.

assert_rejected asserts 422 and that the current source set is unchanged after the refusal (no source, no set delta); the intake refuses the whole pack with no case and only an intake.refused audit row, and an existing case's set stays byte-identical.
Invalid UTF-8 in txt/md/csv, duplicate keys at top level and nested, NaN/Infinity/-Infinity and over-range 1e999/-1e999 are all 422 with no source-set delta.

Proven: finite zero and false are admitted as JSON sources; blank optional workbook cells stay null (never zero); source units (size_mn, margin_bps) preserved; reporting periods and issuer entity derived on the intake wire; RV currency codes validated. Not directly asserted: preservation of signs (negative values), currencies on ingested evidence, and definitions through extraction. Needs a fixture asserting sign/currency/definition text survives block extraction byte-for-byte (the over-wide-line test proves no character is dropped, but not these classes specifically).

A structurally valid PDF with no text layer is admitted (source-set v1) and the intake records it as disposition 'insufficient' with the typed INTAKE_EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT clarification while keeping the scan in the set (classify.py sets text_layer False / signal no_text_layer, which drives that disposition).

Malformed PDF bytes are 422 with no source-set delta; in a pack the malformed member refuses everything and leaves an existing case's set and current run unchanged; the smoke's refused pack creates no case. extract_blocks turns every parser exception into the typed 422 before any store write.

Proven for the loan-universe (CP-3) importer only: externalLinks parts, external relationships, DTD-bearing parts and macro/vba content types are refused before parsing and formulas are never evaluated. The general XLSX source path (sources/domain.py extract_blocks) has no package screening beyond the zip traversal/bomb guards: an .xlsx carrying external relationships or unsafe parts is admitted as evidence. No retained test covers that path.

Proven for the loan-universe importer (data_only load, formula cell -> null, never evaluated). The general XLSX source extractor loads data_only=False and emits the formula string as cell text; that is not a calculated value but it is not null either, and no retained test asserts either behaviour on that path. CLAUDE.md records the silent null import as an open product decision.

Hidden sheets are excluded by the loan-universe importer (sheet_state != visible skipped; 'Hidden' rows never appear). Hidden columns are not handled anywhere (loan_universe.py checks sheet_state only) and no test asserts their exclusion; the general XLSX extractor iterates every worksheet regardless of visibility (no contract requires visible-only there).

Exact below/at/above proven for source bytes (in-process and over HTTP), manifest block rows and intake file count. Row and sheet caps are proven only above the (monkeypatched) ceiling; the column cap (MAX_XLSX_EXTRACT_COLUMNS) and the total-text ceiling are proven above only; the line ceiling is a split, not a refusal, proven for > MAX_BLOCK_CHARS but not at exactly MAX_BLOCK_CHARS. Add at-boundary admission cases for rows, columns, sheets, line width and total text.

Text over MAX_SOURCE_TEXT is 422 (never a prefix); an upload over max_bytes is 413 (the reader takes max+1 and refuses); XLSX over its row/sheet caps is 422; where a document is kept it is kept whole (split and grouped blocks re-join to the exact original text).

Proven over the wire: a PK-prefixed upload with a '../' member and a 20 MB/ratio decompression bomb are 422 (validate_archive: traversal, expanded size, ratio). Guards for absolute paths and member count exist in code but no test drives them; symlink members, duplicate members and nested archive bombs are not checked at all (the archive guard inspects one level of the zip directory). The test also asserts only the status, not the typed detail.

In the production profile the configured clamd is contacted before any vault write and an unreachable scanner is a 503 naming the scanner with no source row and no vault byte (fail closed); the EICAR marker is refused at the helper, the source route and the intake; the scan runs after the size ceiling and before the vault. Weak point: the clamd 'FOUND' response path is exercised by no retained test (only the in-process EICAR marker and the unreachable path); the 'not configured' 503 branch is also untested.

Source bytes are content-addressed under the vault: put() refuses to overwrite an existing digest with different bytes ('existing source identity mismatch'), verify()/read_source_bytes fail closed on tamper; withdrawal is a flag and the row stays retrievable; source-set membership is immutable and the pin never moves. Derivatives (blocks) live on the source row in the store, and the image carries only the tracked tree. Weak point: no test asserts a write-protection mechanism on the vault file itself, only that any change is detected and refused.

Before: prepare_upload hashes the received bytes and Vault.put verifies the digest of what it writes. After: the gate node and acceptance re-verify vault bytes (AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH on tamper), the loan import re-hashes vault bytes against the source digest (RV_SOURCE_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH) and changed stored blocks without a new set are refused.

Proven: line, line-range and line-part locators for text-shaped sources; {sheet, row} locators for the loan-universe importer, preserved through duplicate collapse. Not preserved by the extractor: PDF page locators (pages are joined with newlines and packed by line), XLSX sheet/row/cell locators on general sources (the '[sheet:name]' marker is a text line, the locator is a line number), clause locators; slides are not a supported type. No retained test asserts page, cell or clause locators.

Blocks live on the source row keyed to its sha256 and any drift between stored blocks and the pinned digest is refused at acceptance and at model readiness; the normalized loan universe is a deterministic digest of the workbook bytes and is refused when vault bytes no longer match the source digest; delivered evidence rows carry source provenance.

Identical active bytes are 409 until withdrawal; two concurrent identical uploads on independent PostgreSQL connections admit one active source and one set version; the loan universe keeps exactly one ACTIVE representation per case; in-pack duplicates collapse to one source id.

Proven: a credit agreement and its amendment are both admitted 'used' in one set and the amendment is classified document_type 'amendment' / version_status 'amendment'. Not proven: no link to the base agreement is asserted or carried on the wire (DOCUMENT_KEYS has no base/link field despite the test name), and waivers and supplements have no fixture.

The duplicate manifest row keeps its own filename and shares the original's source id (one source, both names); re-dropped members read 'duplicate' against the existing rows; workbook duplicates collapse to one instrument carrying every sheet/row locator.

Same filename with different bytes is INTAKE_SOURCE_CONFLICT with one finding per file and nothing admitted; conflicting workbook duplicates and identifier mappings are RV_DUPLICATE_CONFLICT / RV_ID_CONFLICT findings that reject the candidate and preserve the prior active universe.

After withdrawal (set v2) the same bytes are admitted as a new source id at set v3 whose membership is only the new id; promotion after withdrawal mints a new identity rather than resurrecting the old row; interleavings on two PostgreSQL connections keep the version history monotonic.

Proven: a failing audit write rolls back the source row, the source-set version and every audit row; a vault write that hits ENOSPC leaves no partial or complete file and no row; a refused pack admits nothing. Not met as written: when the store step fails after a successful vault write, the content-addressed vault blob is kept by design (Task 8 report: 'a blob without a row is not a source') and no test asserts its removal, so 'vault bytes' are not rolled back in that ordering.

Engine._verify_source_vault re-hashes every pinned source's vault bytes at the gate node (pin) and again in _validated_plan_artifacts (acceptance), refusing AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH on mismatch; read_source_bytes refuses SOURCE_BYTES_INTEGRITY_MISMATCH; the loan import re-hashes before activation; model readiness refuses tampered stored blocks. Weak point: read_evidence serves stored blocks rather than re-reading vault bytes, so per-read re-hashing is indirect (block drift is caught by the digest checks above).

A read of another case's source id is AGENT_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH with no foreign text delivered even when the model obeys the document; importing another case's workbook is 404; intake into a foreign case is 404; the route audit drove 20 cross-case id probes with 0 failures.

vault_path/withdrawn_at never appear on upload, list or detail; the source wire is the exact pinned key set on a strict model; DB driver text (host, statement) never reaches the wire; provider adapter identity leaks no key. Scanner outage detail is the fixed string 'malware scanner unavailable' with no host/port (sim_028).

A document instructing the host to change route/issuer is admitted 'used' with no effect on the route and its text never reaches the route reason; web-discovery and forged-contract instructions obeyed by the provider double are refused at the host; forbidden authority keys and smuggled envelope fields are refused; macro/active workbook parts are refused outright rather than executed.

Two spellings of one issuer (NFD/NFC) store as one; U+0958 (expands under NFC) proves normalization runs before the 160-char bound (80 -> 160 stored, 160 -> 422); narrative text is NFC before the revision digest. Scope: applies to pinned analyst strings (case identity, notes, focus questions, deliverable blocks, loan-workbook cells); source document text itself is stored as extracted (recorded non-finding in SPEC_RECONCILIATION).
